title: Istanbul to Bursa by Fast Ferry (İDO / BUDO) vs Osmangazi Bridge
seoTitle: Istanbul to Bursa: İDO & BUDO Ferry vs Osmangazi Bridge
metaDescription: Compare Istanbul to Bursa fast ferries (İDO Yenikapı, BUDO Eminönü/Kabataş) vs driving the Osmangazi Bridge, plus winter wind cancellation tips.
quickAnswer: Fast ferries from Istanbul to Bursa take 1 hour 40 minutes to 1 hour 55 minutes at sea via İDO (Yenikapı or Kadıköy to Güzelyalı) or BUDO (Eminönü/Kabataş to Mudanya), plus 45 to 60 minutes onward into central Bursa. A private car over the Osmangazi Bridge takes 2 hours to 2 hours 30 minutes door to door.

body.text: Which ferry pier (Yenikapı, Eminönü, Kabataş) connects to Mudanya/Güzelyalı?

Two separate operators run Sea of Marmara crossings to Bursa's coast. [BUDO (Bursa Deniz Otobüsleri)](https://budo.burulas.com.tr/en/Budo) sails passenger-only sea buses from Eminönü (and selected [Kabataş sailings](https://budo.burulas.com.tr/tr/Budo/VoyageTime)) directly to Mudanya Pier. [İDO (İstanbul Deniz Otobüsleri)](https://www.ido.com.tr/en/sefer-saatleri/) operates high-speed ferries from Yenikapı and Kadıköy to [İDO Bursa Pier](https://www.ido.com.tr/en/kurumsal/iskelelerimiz/bursa-iskelesi/) in Güzelyalı, about 4 km east of Mudanya.

Match your pier to your Istanbul hotel neighborhood to avoid cross-city traffic. Travelers staying in Sultanahmet or Sirkeci reach BUDO's Eminönü pier in 10 minutes on foot or by T1 tram. Guests in Beyoğlu or Karaköy find Eminönü or Kabataş easiest, while travelers near Aksaray, Yenikapı Marmaray, or Kadıköy on the Asian side connect smoothly to İDO's terminals. Note that both operators run passenger-only catamarans on these main city-center piers; drivers bringing a vehicle use the O-5 highway or Yenikapı–Yalova car ferries instead.
How long does the ferry plus Mudanya transfer take vs direct private car?

Door-to-door travel time is nearly identical for both options when traffic behaves. Taking BUDO or İDO requires 20 minutes of pre-boarding arrival, 100 to 115 minutes on the water, and 45 to 60 minutes from Mudanya or Güzelyalı up to Bursa's city center (Ulu Cami or Çekirge)—totaling 2 hours 45 minutes to 3 hours 15 minutes.

A direct private car via the O-5 Istanbul–İzmir Highway and the Osmangazi Bridge takes 2 hours to 2 hours 30 minutes from central Istanbul outside weekday rush hours. Bridge and highway tolls are calculated by vehicle class on the [Otoyol A.Ş. toll calculator](https://isletme.otoyolas.com.tr/gecis-ucreti-hesapla/) and paid automatically via HGS or card/cash lanes per [Otoyol A.Ş. payment rules](https://isletme.otoyolas.com.tr/sss/).

body.text: When do winter winds cancel Marmara fast ferries?

Strong southwesterly lodos gales and winter poyraz storms between November and March frequently force both BUDO and İDO to cancel Sea of Marmara sailings with only a few hours' notice. Even when Istanbul's Bosphorus looks calm, open-water wave heights off Armutlu and Mudanya often exceed safe catamaran operating thresholds.

Both [BUDO](https://budo.burulas.com.tr/en/Budo) and [İDO](https://www.ido.com.tr/en/sefer-saatleri/) post real-time cancellation alerts on their homepages and notify ticket holders by SMS. If you have a fixed business meeting, thermal-hotel check-in, or same-day flight out of Istanbul between late autumn and early spring, treat the Osmangazi Bridge road route as your primary plan—or keep a backup private driver ready so a lodos morning does not strand your schedule.
How far ahead should weekend ferry tickets be booked?

For Friday afternoon, Saturday morning, and Sunday evening sailings, book BUDO or İDO tickets 5 to 7 days in advance—and 2 to 3 weeks ahead during Turkish public holidays, school breaks, or Uludağ ski weekends. Midweek Tuesday-to-Thursday crossings rarely sell out more than 24 hours ahead, though booking online still secures lower fare tiers.
Follow this pre-trip checklist before heading to Bursa:

items: Confirm pier name on your e-ticket: Do not confuse Mudanya (BUDO) with Güzelyalı (İDO) when arranging a Bursa driver pickup; they sit 10 minutes apart along the coastal road.

Plan the Mudanya–Bursa last mile: Municipal F/1 or 1/M buses connect the piers to Emek Metro Station (about 25 minutes), followed by BursaRay metro into Osmangazi/Şehreküstü, or take a direct taxi in 35 to 45 minutes.
Check weather 12 hours prior: Look for lodos wind advisories in autumn and winter before committing to morning ferry departures.
Carry your ID for boarding: Both operators verify passenger names and require you to pass pier turnstiles 10 to 15 minutes before departure.

faq.q: How do I get from Mudanya or Güzelyalı pier to Bursa city center?
faq.a: Take a direct metered taxi (35–45 minutes) or board a municipal Burulaş bus from right outside the pier to Emek Station, then ride the BursaRay light rail straight to Şehreküstü (near Ulu Cami and Koza Han).

faq.q: Can you take a rental car on the BUDO or İDO Bursa ferry?
faq.a: BUDO carries foot passengers only. İDO's Yenikapı–Güzelyalı route primarily uses passenger sea buses; if you are driving a rental car, crossing via the Osmangazi Bridge on the O-5 highway is faster and avoids ferry queues.

faq.q: Does BUDO depart from Eminönü or Kabataş?
faq.a: BUDO's primary Istanbul terminal for Mudanya sailings is Eminönü (near the Galata Bridge), with selected schedules referencing Kabataş. Always verify the exact departure pier shown on your ticket confirmation on budo.burulas.com.tr.

faq.q: Is Bursa doable as a day trip from Istanbul?
faq.a: Yes. Taking a 07:30–08:30 ferry or departing by car at 07:30 lets you visit Ulu Cami, Koza Han, Green Mosque, and have İskender kebap before returning on an 18:30–19:30 sailing. Adding Uludağ cable car makes an overnight stay far more comfortable.

faq.q: What happens to my ticket if İDO or BUDO cancels due to weather?
faq.a: When an operator cancels a crossing for adverse sea conditions, passengers receive a full refund or free transfer to the next available sailing under the carrier's published [travelling terms](https://budo.burulas.com.tr/tr/Budo/TravellingTerms?pageno=0).

faq.q: How much luggage can I bring on Istanbul–Bursa fast ferries?
faq.a: Both İDO and BUDO accommodate standard suitcases (typically up to 20–30 kg per passenger) in designated cabin luggage racks without extra check-in counters, though oversized ski gear or heavy trunks are much easier in a private van.
